I am old now, fifty years, and I have no schooling, but I have grown rice on this small plot for many years. The land is mine, so I will work it well. I will buy small fertilizer if the agro-dealer has it at fair price — urea helps rice very much — but I cannot afford the full amount they tell us in the radio. My plot is fadama-type lowland where rice grows, so the water comes from the rains and the low place; I do not have pump irrigation. My sons and wife will help me, and at transplanting and harvest I must hire some hands because the work is too much for one family alone.
